phytogeography.definition: n. The geographical distribution of plants.

phytographical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to phytography.

phytography.definition:
n. The science of describing plants in a systematic
   manner; also, a description of plants.
phytography.translation: n. [植]记述植物学,植物分类学

phytohormone.definition: n. (botany) a plant product that acts like a hormone
phytohormone.translation:
n. 植物激素, 植物生长素
[化] 植物激素

phytolacca.definition: n type genus of Phytolaccaceae: pokeweed

phytolaccaceae.definition: n. chiefly tropical herbaceous plants (including shrubs and trees) with racemose flowers: genera Phytolacca, Agdestis, Ercilla, Rivina, Trichostigma

phytolite.definition: n. An old name for a fossil plant.

phytolithology.definition:
n. The branch of science which treats of fossil
   plants; -- usually called paleobotany, sometimes paleophytology.

phytoliths.translation: (phytolith 的复数) n.[古生]植物化石,植物岩

phytological.definition: a. Of or pertaining to phytology; botanical.

phytologist.definition:
n. One skilled in phytology; a writer on plants; a
   botanist.
phytologist.translation: n. 植物学家（等于botany） (phytology的变形)

phytology.definition: n the branch of biology that studies plants

phytomastigina.translation: [网络] 植鞭亚纲；A植鞭亚纲；植鞭毛虫类

phytomedicine.translation: [网络] 植物医学；植物药；植物医学期刊

phytomer.translation: n. [植]植物繁殖单位(如植物茎上的节等)

phytometer.translation: 植物计, 植物蒸腾表

phyton.definition:
n. One of the parts which by their repetition make up a
   flowering plant, each being a single joint of a stem with its leaf or
   leaves; a phytomer.
phyton.translation: n. 植物机构单位； 植物繁殖单位

phytonadione.definition: n a form of vitamin K
phytonadione.translation: n. [化]植物甲萘醌,维生素K&-{1}(用作凝血药)

phytonomy.definition: n. The science of the origin and growth of plants.

phytons.translation: n. 植物繁殖单位；植物结构单位

phytopaleontology.translation: n. [古生]植物化石学,古植物学

phytopathologist.definition: n. One skilled in diseases of plants.

phytopathology.definition: n. The science of diseases to which plants are liable.

phytophaga.definition: n. pl. A division of Hymenoptera; the sawflies.

phytophagic.translation: a. [动物学]食植物的, 食叶类的, 食草的

phytophagineae.translation: [医] 植物病毒亚目(病毒目)

phytophagous.translation: a. (昆虫)食植(物)的, 食叶类的

phytophthora.definition: n. destructive parasitic fungi causing brown rot in plants

phytoplankton.definition: n. photosynthetic or plant constituent of plankton; mainly unicellular algae
phytoplankton.translation:
n. 浮游植物
[医] 浮游植物

phytosanitary.translation: a. 植物检疫的,控制植物(尤指农作物)病害的

phytosociological.translation: a. phytosociology（植物社会学）的变形

phytosphingosine.translation: 植物鞘氨醇, 4-羟双氢(神经)鞘氨醇

phytosterin.translation:
[化] 植物甾醇
[医] 植物甾醇(旧名)

phytotherapy.definition: n. the use of plants or plant extracts for medicinal purposes (especially plants that are not part of the normal diet)
phytotherapy.translation:
n. 植物治疗法, 本草疗法
[医] 植物[药]疗法

phytotomy.definition: n. The dissection of plants; vegetable anatomy.

phytotoxin.definition: n any substance produced by plants that is similar in its properties to extracellular bacterial toxin

phytoxylin.translation: [医] 植木胶(一种类似火棉胶的物质)

phytozoon.definition:
n. A plantlike animal. The term is sometimes applied to
   zoophytes.
